title: Automate onboarding and perf profiles for aurora-glimmer-13b v1.0 (metadata + changelog)
author: Priya Patel
description: Context: This PR adds automated onboarding for the new community model 'aurora-glimmer-13b' into the model registry and generates an initial set of performance profiles, metadata, and an automated changelog entry. Motivation: onboarding is error-prone when done manually and perf-profile generation should be reproducible so downstream serving and routing picks the optimal kernels/quantization profiles automatically. What this changes: 1) Adds models/aurora-glimmer/metadata.yaml with canonical metadata (model family, tokenizer, hf repo URL, recommended sequence lengths, quantization hints). 2) Adds perf-profiles/aurora-glimmer-13b-v1.json generated by the perf-lab harness with latency/throughput profiles across our supported GPU types and typical sequence-length buckets. 3) Integrates the model into the registry manifest and CI gating so model is validated on PR. 4) Adds a small automation script scripts/registry_changelog_bot.py which creates a changelog entry using our changelog templating rules and attaches perf-summary. 5) Adds tests/test_aurora_glimmer_profiles.py to validate profile schema and a smoke inference test using the local perf-canary harness. Checklist: - [x] metadata file created and schema-validated - [x] perf profile generated from benchmark-lab and schema-validated - [x] changelog automation script added and invoked by CI - [x] unit tests and small integration smoke test passing - [x] reviewers approved - [x] merge and published manifest Notes on automation: The scripts/registry_changelog_bot.py is a small adapter that pulls perf-summary from the perf-lab run artifacts (S3 path configurable), formats the release notes section, and appends to changelogs/models/aurora-glimmer-13b.md. It is intentionally idempotent and guarded by a dry-run flag. The onboarding flow in the CI now runs perf-lab in a restricted mode (reduced sample count) and validates the generated perf profile against the profile schema; full perf benchmarking is still done in nightly runs. Migration/rollout: This adds metadata and profiles only; serving runtime is unaffected until the model is enabled in the runtime manifest. Ops: When promoting to Dedicated or Private channels, ops should ensure model weights are available in the private artifactory and adjust the S3 path for perf artifacts. Testing: Added unit tests and CI integration which re-runs the perf-schema check; one flaky test (smoke inference on a specific GPU simulator) was re-run and passed. Risks: small risk of schema drift if perf-lab changes profile keys; mitigated by schema version field and pre-merge validation. Related: ENG-2145 for onboarding automation work and SUP-4821 customer request to add aurora-glimmer to allowed models. Merge: squash and merge.
